instructions: Ben's recorded calls from Call Recorder: AI-written notes, full transcripts (who said what, with timestamps), Ben's own notes, and action items. Use search_calls to find where something was discussed, then get_call for the full notes or transcript. In transcripts, "Ben" is Ben's microphone. Other people are labeled by name when their voice was recognized or named; "Speaker 1", "Speaker 2"… are voices nobody has named yet, and "Them" is everyone else mixed together (older calls). "Mic" means only the microphone was recorded, so it can be either side. Quote the call title and date when you answer from a call.

tools.name: search_calls
list_calls
tools.description:
List recorded calls, newest first, with who was on them and a one-paragraph summary. since/until are
    dates (YYYY-MM-DD); person filters by participant name or email.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description:
Read one call. call_id is the id from search_calls/list_calls, "last" for the most recent call, or a
    unique part of its title. part="notes" gives the AI notes (summary, notes, decisions, action items,
    open questions) plus your own notes; part="transcript" gives the full timestamped transcript, in pages
    of max_chars — pass the next_offset it reports to continue.

tools.name: list_action_items
tools.description:
Action items from recorded calls, newest calls first. owner filters by who owns the item (a name, or
    "me" for your own); since/until are dates (YYYY-MM-DD).
